name: Decal_Crack_Wide_01
class: decal (alpha decal texture set; no mesh)

textures.channels: base colour sRGB + opacity in alpha
tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (0)

material_exception: decal set private to this decal; a deferred decal cannot use the tiling library sets of ART_STANDARD.md section 2
source_note: the source is the height field generated by the build script (seeded, deterministic); the .blend holds the review scene with the decal blended over the ground
origin_ids_note: the family shares its origin IDs between all of its frames; this decal dresses the placements that show frame 89/2
dresses: wide ground crack, 1.8 m long and up to 8 cm across, ragged with side cracks
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A flat decal: the fissure is a black gap with a normal-map lip, with no parallax, so from a low camera it reads as painted. It suits flat ground only; it does not follow terrain relief or change the ground material. Colours assume brown earth; on grass or stone the crumbled lip will look like scattered soil. Unreal decal material is not built here.
